ops.title: Never run gd-build docs builds locally as a pre-ship gate — docs CI via ship watch is the gate
ops.body:
Do not run the local gd-build docs build (`uv run --with ...gd-build build`) as a pre-ship verification gate in captain-hook, even though AGENTS.md's Docs rule describes the command ("must keep the docs build green"). The user stopped a mid-flight local build with "dont build the docs locally, stop doing that" (2026-07-20).

**Why:** The docs deploy workflow runs the identical build in CI on push, and `ccx vcs ship` watches every workflow on the pushed commit — a local run is redundant, slow (gd-build's 300s default cap kills it mid-render; the full build needs `GD_BUILD_TIMEOUT` raised), and `uv run --with` without `--no-sync` prunes the dev extra out of the shared `.venv` while other work runs.

**How to apply:** Skip the local gd-build step when writing/executing plans; verification of docs-affecting changes = `ccx vcs ship` CI watch, with a red docs run handed to `cc-context:ci-triage`. Local docs work stays fine for iterating on content the user asked for — the ban is on gate/verification builds. See [[uv-sync-group-clobbers-extras]].
